segments.text:
V. 30.
They paſſed thro' Galilee—Tho' not thro' the Cities, but by them, in the moſt private ways. He was not willing that any ſhould know it: For he taught his diſciples—He wanted to be alone with them ſome Time, in order to inſtruct them fully concerning his Sufferings. The Son of man is delivered—It is as ſure, as if it were done already.
